from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors

eugenin_smiles = 'CC1=CC(=O)C2=C(C=C(C=C2O1)OC)O'
lysinoalanine_smiles = 'C(CCNCC(C(=O)O)N)CC(C(=O)O)N'

mol_eugenin = Chem.MolFromSmiles(eugenin_smiles)
mol_lysinoalanine = Chem.MolFromSmiles(lysinoalanine_smiles)

mw_eugenin = Descriptors.MolWt(mol_eugenin)
mw_lysinoalanine = Descriptors.MolWt(mol_lysinoalanine)
